sn5.3:1.2: Regarded as the foremost of those who wear coarse robes ([an1.246:1.1]()), she has a different set of verses at [thig10.1:0.3]().
sn5.3:2.4: Māra evidently believes that a grieving mother’s first priority is to seek a lover in a dark forest.
sn5.3:5.4: She addresses Māra as _āvuso_. This is obviously a case where _āvuso_ does not mean “friend”.
